description: Migrate remaining Firebase-dependent files: admin panels, CallProvider, push notifications, error reporting, platform services. Replace Firebase Storage with Cloudinary for avatar upload. Remove Firebase dependencies entirely.
steps: Migrate src/services/platform/platform.ts: Remove Firestore import and addDoc for admin_audit_logs. The function already writes to Supabase as secondary - make that the only write. Remove all firebase/firestore imports.
Migrate src/hooks/usePushNotifications.ts: Replace Firestore setDoc to push_tokens with supabase.from('push_tokens').upsert(). Remove firebase/firestore and @/lib/firebase imports.
Migrate src/lib/errorReporting.ts: Replace Firestore addDoc to 'error_logs' with supabase.from('error_logs').insert(). Remove firebase imports.

Migrate src/pages/ProfileCreation.tsx: Replace Firebase Storage upload (ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL) with uploadToCloudinary from '@/lib/cloudinary'. Replace Firestore setDoc for profiles with supabase.from('profiles').upsert(). Replace Firestore getDoc/setDoc for usernames with supabase equivalent.
Migrate src/pages/admin-os/ApprovalsInbox.tsx: Replace all Firestore onSnapshot listeners and runTransaction with supabase real-time and supabase.from() operations.
Migrate src/pages/admin-os/AppointmentsPanel.tsx: Replace Firestore addDoc/getDocs with supabase.from() equivalents.
Migrate src/pages/admin-os/VerificationQueue.tsx: Replace Firestore onSnapshot, updateDoc, runTransaction with supabase equivalents.
Migrate src/contexts/CallProvider.tsx: Replace all Firestore operations (addDoc, updateDoc, getDocs, onSnapshot for calls signaling) with supabase.from() and supabase real-time channels.
Delete src/lib/firebase.ts entirely - it should no longer be imported anywhere.
Remove the 'firebase' package from package.json dependencies. Run 'bun install' to update the lockfile.
Remove firestore.rules and storage.rules files from the project root.
Update vite.config.ts: Remove the firebase-related manualChunks entries (vendor-firebase-auth, vendor-firebase-storage, vendor-firebase) since Firebase is no longer a dependency.
Run TypeScript check and full build to confirm everything compiles cleanly
acceptance_criteria: No file in src/ imports from '@/lib/firebase' or 'firebase/*'
ProfileCreation.tsx uses uploadToCloudinary for avatar uploads
vite.config.ts has no firebase chunk references
verification: Run 'grep -r "firebase" src/ --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" | grep -v node_modules' and confirm no firebase imports remain
Run 'bunx tsc --noEmit' and confirm no new type errors
Run 'bun run build' and confirm build succeeds
Run 'bun run test -- --run' and confirm tests pass
findings: Many more files than originally listed in the feature steps still had firebase imports (Messages, Conversation, Profile, Drafts, LiveHost, LiveList, LiveViewer, Compose, StoryCompose, Onboarding, EditProfile, ReelCompose, Support, Verification, VirtualWorld, RecruitmentCenter, FinanceDepartment, useVirtualWorld, useWalletOS, organization.service, Assistant, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword, DeleteAccountScreen, integrations/firebase/client). All were successfully migrated. TypeScript check passes. Build succeeds. The 1 actual test passes. The 7 vitest/bun internal errors are pre-existing (documented in FEAT-003 findings).
